QuestInfo.name: Check Out the Orange Mushroom
QuestInfo.0: This is your first assignment as an informant. You're here to ask #b#p1300007##k in #b#m100000000##k about possible reasons for the #o1210102#'s strange behavior.
QuestInfo.1: #p1300007# says the #o1210102#s with strange facial expressions might be the key. Eliminate #r#o9300274##ks and get one #b#t4034062##k.\r\n\r\n#questorder1##i4034062:# #t4034062:# #c4034062# / 1
QuestInfo.2: You brought the #t4034062# you found. #p1300007# says he'll examine it and let you know if he learns anything from it.

0.0: I did hear strange types of #o1210102#s are appearing near Henesys lately. Glad to see you here! You can do the field research in my place.
0.1: I did hear that #b#o1210102#s with strange faces#k are turning up near Henesys. Please check out the #b#m100010001#s#k and bring me any clues you find.
0.2: You will be able to find out what's wrong with the #o1210102#s, after you defeat an #o1210102# and see what item it drops. Whichever item it drops, just bring #b20#k back to me.

yes.0: #m100010001# is on the way to #m104020000#.\r\nIf you meet any #b#o9300274#s#k there, bring me whatever they drop when you clobber them.\r\n#e#b(If you accept, you'll travel to the quest map automatically.)#k#n

no.0: Hm? Are you scared of #o1210102#s? They're not that strong, really. I hope you're not worried about the whole #o1210102# takeover conspiracy theory that's been going around. That's just just the crazies talking.

1.0: Oh, you're back! That means you pummeled #o9300274# in the name of research, right? Show me what you found.

yes.0: #t4034062#... This doll might be related to the strange #o1210102#s near #m100000000#. I have to take a closer look at this. It may take some time.

item.0: You haven't defeated #o9300274# yet? Beat some up and bring me the item the #r#o9300274##k drops. You just need to bring #b1#k item that you can't get from #o1210102#s.
